findings.summary: Self-review mutation-checked the pointer test: removing 'never fixed sleeps', 'Rely on Playwright actionability' or the shortcuts sentence from AGENTS.md each fails test_browser_changes_are_load_tested_before_pr; the unmutated text passes.

The plan's third criterion first said every governance suite reading AGENTS.md must pass; locally test_worktree_lifecycle has one Windows-only failure (test_ephemeral_invocation_lease_blocks_concurrent_retirement: the venv launcher PID differs from the interpreter PID) that fails identically on the pre-change plan commit. Before publishing the plan, the criterion was restated as 'no outcome change versus pre-change bytes, plus Azure CI', which is what the package can honestly prove.
AGENTS.md stays under its 750-word cap; the bullet adds no new gate for documentation-only or control-only changes, and adds no CI configuration.
